name: Gearbox Fault Diagnosis Data
summary: Vibration signals recorded in four directions from a two-stage gearbox with healthy and broken-tooth gears under varying load.

attributes.name: sensor1..4
attributes.description: Measurements from vibration sensors mounted in four directions; the source CSV columns are a1 through a4.

attributes.name: condition
attributes.description: Healthy (h) or broken-tooth (b) condition encoded in the file name.

attributes.name: load
attributes.description: Load from 0% through 90% in 10% increments, encoded in the file name.

notes: The dataset contains 20 files: two conditions at ten load levels.
Condition and load are encoded in file names rather than CSV columns.
citation: Pandya, Y. and Parey, A. Gearbox Fault Diagnosis Data. OpenEI submission 623.
